rca_of_the_issue: The Roster page header (RosterPage.js line 515) uses 'flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap' but flex-wrap only triggers when content exceeds container. At 1280px, the total button widths (Import CAP Report ~150px + Add Participant ~169px + gap + other elements) exceed available space but the buttons themselves don't shrink because they have fixed text content. The Schedule page header works better because it has more buttons that naturally wrap earlier. Solution: Add responsive classes like 'xl:flex-nowrap lg:flex-wrap' or set a max-width with overflow handling.
